description: Let autumn be the word the stock can keep.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Took three twopences, and no one further than the outer stair.
name: Davy Gannet

description: Eight shillings set aside for her from the stock part, payable Thursday.
name: Edith Kettlewood

description: Refused a price and a date before autumn.
name: John Heminges

description: Asked for seven yards in grain, and accepted the wait.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Admired the peach and did not ask for it.
name: Will Kemp

description: Ruled the columns, entered the part, and stopped before a total.
name: William Shakespeare
